'''2001 DragonCon Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open championship on 1 September 2001 at DragonCon in Atlanta, Georgia. 44 players came.<ref name="tr-z">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001d2938/ z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001], Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, DeckTech (6 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001d2938/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Six Swiss rounds led to a final confrontation.<ref name="tr-myers">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-dragoncon-2k1-aka-timed-wins-suckd2935/ dragoncon-2k1-aka-timed-wins-suck], Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, DeckTech (5 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-dragoncon-2k1-aka-timed-wins-suckd2935/ GitHub Pages].</ref> [[Andy McClure]] won with a Dark [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]] list. His only loss was to [[Chris Praskac]]'s Watch Your Step in the final.<ref name="dt-18806">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18806 I lose to Dagobah- DragonCon winning DS], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 6 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18806/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18806/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 1 September 2001
* '''Site:''' DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
